description: A light gray T-shirt lies on a red bedspread in front of a white pillow and headboard. The left hand and right hand move in to spread the shirt flat, then the right hand folds the right side inward toward the center while the left hand steadies the fabric; next the left hand folds the left side over, and both hands square the edges before folding the bottom up toward the top to make a compact rectangle, then both hands release.
